text:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Monday 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30 work for you? If not, Tuesday 24 Nov 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30 are also free on my side.

Best,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

Monday 23 November, 10:00-10:30 works for me. It's on my calendar now and I've logged it: BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah.

Please put it on yours so we both have it, and if anything changes on your side let me know and we'll move it to one of the other slots.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Thank you — Monday 23 November, 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar too, and I've logged it: BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Alvarez. I'll let you know straight away if anything changes.

Best,
Sarah

Perfect — then it's confirmed on both sides. See you Monday at 10:00.

Professor Alvarez
Confirmed on both sides — see you Monday at 10:00. Thank you, Professor Alvarez.
